technology_name: LED BASED SPHERICAL INTEGRATING NEPHELOMETER WITH MINIMIZED TRUNCATION ERROR FOR AEROSOL LIGHT SCATTERING MEASUREMENTS AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Legacy integrating nephelometers exhibit severe geometric truncation errors at extreme forward and backward angles, reducing the precision of aerosol light scattering coefficients.
description: An LED-based spherical integrating nephelometer architecture optimized to capture scattering coefficients accurately across a wide angular spectrum ranging from 0.65 to 179.61 degrees while maintaining a compact instrument layout.
applications: Climate research stations, urban air quality monitoring arrays, meteorological sensor networks, and environmental safety nodes.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
